title: My School Day
text:
I go to school every day. My favorite subject is English because I like new words. In the morning we have math and then science.

Anna likes drawing. She draws animals in art class. Her friend likes music and sings in the school choir.

questions.text: What is the writer's favorite subject?
What does Anna draw in art class?
Why does the writer like English?
options: They do not go to school

questions.text: What can we guess about Anna's friend?

vocabulary.definition: units of language that have a meaning
makes a picture with a pen or pencil
living things that are not plants or people
a group of people who sing together

paragraph_translations: Chodzę do szkoły każdego dnia. Moim ulubionym przedmiotem jest angielski, ponieważ lubię uczyć się nowych słów. Rano mamy matematykę, a potem przyrodę.
Anna lubi rysować. Na lekcji plastyki rysuje zwierzęta. Jej przyjaciel lubi muzykę i śpiewa w szkolnym chórze.
